description: Migrate GitHub org repository permission model from per-repo permissions to team-based RBAC. Must: inventory current per-repo permissions, define team structure and roles, create teams and assign members, apply team-based permissions to repos, enable branch protection rules, verify access is correct per team, and remove legacy per-repo permissions. Risk factors: access loss during migration, branch protection blocking existing workflows, team structure not matching org hierarchy. Tools available: GitHub API, terraform, ansible, gh CLI.
